subject: design-technology
title: Cradle to Cradle
welcome_lead: McDonough and Braungart's manifesto: waste equals food.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: Cradle to Cradle, circular design and biomimicry.
final_note: Design out waste from the start.

concepts.def: Material that returns safely to the biosphere.
Material that cycles indefinitely within industry.
Re-using waste at equal or higher value than original use.

walkthroughs.body_html: William McDonough and Michael Braungart published Cradle to Cradle: Remaking the Way We Make Things in 2002. The book itself was printed on a synthetic 'plastic paper' to demonstrate the concept.

Materials should sit in one of two metabolisms: biological (composts back to soil) or technical (recycles industrially forever). Mixing the two — composite plastics with toxic dyes — creates 'monstrous hybrids'.
The Cradle to Cradle Certified™ standard rates products across material health, reuse, renewable energy, water and social fairness — Basic to Platinum.
